organic_results.snippet: People say  "nowhere"   to mean  in no place ,  at no place , or  not anywhere . It acts as the opposite of  somewhere .   Collins Dictionary  +2 Common Meanings and Uses No physical place:  Describing something that cannot be found ( "His keys were nowhere to be found" ). Remote locations:  Expressing that a place is very far away or isolated ( "They live in the middle of nowhere" ). Lack of progress:  Showing that an action or plan leads to no result ( "Our talks are going nowhere" ). Sudden appearance:  Saying something or someone showed up unexpectedly ( "He came out of nowhere" ).   YouTube · iswearenglish  +4 Word Origins The word comes from Old English  nahwær , combining  no  and  where . It is a single negative word, meaning "no place," rather than a combination of the words "now" and "here".   Quora  +1 YouTube · iswearenglish 7m Road to Nowhere Meaning - Get Nowhere Examples QuillBot No Where or Nowhere | Meaning & Example Sentences - QuillBot No Where or Nowhere | Meaning & Example Sentences.
